Components.Title: Veridant
Components.Description: A Mediterranean cliffside resort at sunset after rain: a wet courtyard round its reflecting pool, travertine terraces, a colonnaded cafe and a gallery lounge, and the bay beyond with a superyacht and a hilltop village on the headland.
